notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Cast Dire Fleet Ravager by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dire Fleet Ravager enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Archfiend of Despair and Glasspool Mimic trigger.
Resolve the Archfiend of Despair trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

uses.name: Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore
uses.cardState: as a copy of Archfiend of Despair
